title: What Growing Sculpture Parks Is
definition: Growing Sculpture Parks: parks of sculptures that keep growing.
description:
Growing Sculpture Parks is parks of sculptures that keep growing. It sits squarely in Future Art, Design & Fashion, the frontier where living armatures science becomes park logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are decades-long care-scale. Societies that master park hulls early will shape pruning plans practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why living armatures programs worldwide now treat Growing Sculpture Parks as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Growing Sculpture Parks needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Growing Sculpture Parks
definition: Estimates Growing Sculpture Parks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Growing Sculpture Parks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a park hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Growing Sculpture Parks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Growing Sculpture Parks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Growing Sculpture Parks — parks of sculptures that keep growing.

Phase 1 — Prove (living armatures): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (park logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (pruning plans): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (decades-long care): park hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
